## Purpose

Implements the run-history browser: the searchable/filterable list of past runs grouped into
revision families, plus a detail view that replays a selected run's deliverable and per-agent
trace. Depended on by `components/layout` (mounts it as the History surface).

## Shape

- [WorkflowHistory.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/WorkflowHistory.tsx) (~1135 lines) — the top-level surface: fetches the run list
  (`getWorkflows`), owns search/filter/type-tab state, and renders either the family-grouped
  list or a selected run's detail. **Reuses `preview`'s renderers directly** (`PPTPreview`,
  `UserStoryPreview`, `PrototypePreview`, `MarkdownPreview`, `AppBuilderPreview`) and
  `results`'s tabs (`FilesTab`, `AgentThinkingTab`, `AuditTab`) to render a reopened run
  identically to a live one, rather than a parallel read-only view.
- [RevisionFamilyView.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/RevisionFamilyView.tsx) — sibling module (split out to keep [WorkflowHistory.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/WorkflowHistory.tsx)
  manageable) holding: `groupRunsByFamily`/`bucketAndSortFamilies` (client-side grouping of
  flat run rows by root run id), `FamilyGroupCard` (the collapsed family row), and
  `VersionTimeline` (the chip row for walking a family's versions, shared with
  `RunDetailPage`).
- [RunDetailPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/RunDetailPage.tsx) — a self-contained "run summary" page fed by a single `getRunSummary`
  endpoint: KPI strip, per-agent breakdown, `VersionTimeline`, and (reusing `preview`'s
  `DegradedRunAffordance`) a terminal-failure banner. Distinct from `WorkflowHistory`'s own
  inline detail view — used when a caller wants a lightweight summary without mounting the
  full deliverable renderers.
- Two navigation paths into a run's detail coexist: `onOpenRun` (routes into the shared live
  run screen — chat lane, composer, SSE reattachment) is preferred when the caller wires it;
  `setSelectedRun`'s internal `RunDetailPage`/inline-detail rendering is the legacy fallback
  for callers that don't.
- **Auto-refresh**: both [WorkflowHistory.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/WorkflowHistory.tsx) (the list) and [RunDetailPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/RunDetailPage.tsx) independently
  implement the same manual-refresh + interval-refresh pattern (`Off`/`10s`/`15s`/`30s`/`1m`, a
  `Loader2` spinner while a fetch is in flight, a countdown tied to a ticker effect kept separate
  from the fetch-trigger effect so "0 / reloading" is visibly shown, not skipped atomically).
- **Real workflow names for dynamic-catalog types**: [RevisionFamilyView.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/RevisionFamilyView.tsx)'s
  `resolveWorkflowTypeLabel(type, shortNameFor)` resolves a run's display label — curated
  `TYPE_META` entry first, else the live catalog's `short_name` (via `useWorkflowShortNames`,
  `@/hooks/useWorkflowMetadata`), else a humanized fallback — used by both `FamilyGroupCard`'s
  label and `DivertBadge`'s "Diverted to X" text, so a spec-014 `ex_A*` fixture (or any future
  catalog-only type) shows its real name instead of generic "Custom". `filterBucketFor(type)`
  (same file) buckets every type outside the 4 known frameworks into the "custom" filter tab, so
  those same dynamic types are counted and findable there too.
- Imports `components/preview` and `components/results` (deliverable + tab reuse),
  `components/ui` (`Badge`, `Tabs`), and `lib` (`parseRunInput`, `runStats`, `clarifications`,
  `workflowChaining`, the `api` client).

## Why this shape

Revision-family grouping and version-walking logic live in [RevisionFamilyView.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/RevisionFamilyView.tsx) as a
sibling module purely to keep the already-large [WorkflowHistory.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/WorkflowHistory.tsx) from growing further —
it is not a separate abstraction layer, just an extraction. Several of its formatting helpers
(`cleanDisplayTitle`, `TYPE_META`, `formatDate`) are near-duplicates of ones inline in
[WorkflowHistory.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/history/WorkflowHistory.tsx), copied rather than shared to avoid a circular import back into it.

The module **deliberately does not re-implement deliverable rendering or per-agent trace UI**:
every renderer and tab it shows is imported from `preview`/`results` so a reopened historical
run and a live run render byte-identically, and `RunDetailPage` explicitly reuses
`PreviewPanel`'s exported `DegradedRunAffordance` for the same reason (documented inline as
"no dual implementation").

The two coexisting navigation paths (shared live run screen vs. legacy internal detail)
reflect an in-progress migration — newer call sites wire `onOpenRun` to get SSE reattachment
and the full chat lane; the internal `RunDetailPage`/selected-run path remains for backward
compatibility with callers that haven't been updated.
